items.intent: Stable admission MUST use authoritative canonical identity, watcher policy ID and explicit reevaluation generation; bind exact original bytes and effective policy at first admission. No text equality or mutable rule hash may replace stable admission identity.
SQLite uniqueness, bounded snapshots/attempts and owner/generation predicates MUST survive process restart; negative and failed results, usage and replay tombstones MUST be durable.

The existing plugin lifecycle MUST own a bounded dispatcher (5s poll, 30s lease, 10s renew, one active classifier, at most 10 candidates/tick). Only proven unsubmitted failures retry after 5s/30s, maximum three attempts. Ambiguous admitted work MUST NOT automatically recall providers.
Every certified recipient MUST commit SQLite admission before queue dispatch and settle SQLite before queue acknowledgement; missing/mismatched admitted evidence MUST NOT enqueue again.

Positive/suggestion/recipient materialization MUST be durable, recipient-specific and authority checked; legacy retry must be fenced, source-window count and first-sent cooldown applied once, expired payloads cannot dispatch even through generic queue recovery with the watcher absent, and all receipt-bound copies are redacted without clearing replay identity. The first confirmed send MUST preserve one idempotent owner-reply row with frozen suggestions and a window that recovery cannot restart.
Both hook and flow classifier/suggestion paths MUST use opt-in per-invocation final usage from the installed terminal result, preserving ordinary callers and honest unknown/incomplete cost.

Explicit cron agent/session binding MUST fail closed at admission and execution, before lossy input normalization and at effective candidate-copy update, preserving stored session scope and leaving rejected memory/disk state unchanged; omitted general-cron agent retains defaults; qualified Pulse execution MUST use its current exact gateway and no automatic announcement.

Eligibility/census/shadow MUST be accepted and resolved through the real strict plugin manifest/loader, default disabled, never bypass baseline, exclude uncertified/custom/model-drift inputs, and export complete logical-source accounting or explicit incomplete coverage. No active classifier change or paid holdout occurs here.

Provenance, receipt IDs and scores MUST NOT grant authority. Current enablement/owner/recipient scope MUST be rechecked before dispatch and local completion through source-qualified authority evidence. Missing/stale DB mirror or missing JSON account mapping MUST NOT inherit fail-open fallback authority. Data migrations/rollback MUST preserve uncertain admissions and tombstones.
Two hooks for one qualified source/policy produce one admission; equal IDs in different chats produce two.
Kill/restart tests at every specified effect boundary cause zero automatic repeat of a possibly accepted call or a confirmed recipient delivery.
Every tested terminal invocation records supplied usage with actual resolved model or explicit unknown; no guessed complete bill passes qualification.
Invalid explicit cron binding dispatches zero tools or provider calls; valid isolated jobs preserve agent ownership and origin binding.
Disabled census/shadow dispatches zero extra calls; enabled fixture shadow always retains baseline and logical-source accounting.

All acceptance cases map to real source, installed lock versions, process/SQLite/queue tests, repository gates and independent review. Source proof is distinguished from deployment/live qualification.

items.intent: Given equal provider IDs in different chats, when both arrive, then both are admitted; given two hook representations of one source/policy, only one admission exists.
Given a debounced batch, when received hook fires, then each ordered original unit is matched separately using its exact source text.

Given a redelivery after policy/model change, then it resumes its pinned input/policy; changed bytes under the same immutable source ID conflict. Verified provider edit revision or explicit authorized reevaluation creates a distinct linked admission.
Given missing/unqualified provenance or a manual/flow RPC, then baseline invocation remains available, uses fresh identity and cannot suppress other sources or enter the complaint experiment.

Given one queued source, when two processes claim it, then one lease generation owns dispatch. Expired admitted work becomes indeterminate; received work resumes local processing without another classifier call.
Given a valid positive with an uncertain suggestion request, then recovery uses explicit unavailable suggestions and still publishes the positive alert without another suggestion call.

Given two recipients and success at one, when the other fails or process restarts, then the confirmed recipient never receives a second send. Cooldown is stamped once at the first confirmed sent receipt.
Given SQLite admission but missing/mismatched queue evidence, then the recipient becomes indeterminate rather than recreated. Queue terminal evidence survives until SQLite settlement.

Given expired private payloads, then payload copies are erased within the retention policy while minimal replay tombstones remain; old events cannot recreate inference or delivery. Legacy pending alerts stay visible as `legacy_unreconciled` and do not automatically fan out.
Given opted-in successful runs, each emits one final usage record from its returned resolved model; host-inferred usage is suppressed only for that run.
Given SDK failure or fallback without earlier-attempt usage, retain supplied usage and unknown/incomplete coverage; do not price all attempts as the final model.
Given an unopted host caller, preserve its existing public signatures and lifecycle/usage behavior.
Explicit nonempty unknown/deleted agent rejects at admission and execution; a cross-agent/global explicit origin session rejects rather than rewriting to main.
Omitted agent ID retains general-cron default behavior. Valid isolated work retains isolated execution session in the same agent namespace and its validated origin binding.

Pulse's `scope:session`, explicit agent/session and `delivery.mode:none` produce no automatic announcement. Hub activation requires exact gateway qualification evidence; scheduling receipt is not execution evidence.
Only certified-source/default-effective-policy/model-revision matches are eligible. No eligible traffic returns a stop decision, not an activation request.
Every shadow case still executes baseline; timeout/abstention never become a negative classification.

Gate, forwarded baseline, retry and unknown bills use one logical-source denominator and export separate model/policy cohorts. Active promotion remains disabled without the parent experiment protocol and separate paid authorization.
